title: Corpus review
description: A reviewer's decisions on the candidate windows one discovery run offers for review: the selected windows, the audit sample and the sibling windows, never a window of a locked stream while no custodian policy allows it. An included window's frames join a frozen corpus version under its stream's group and split. An observation records what the reviewer saw and is not a label: labels come only from the annotation contract.

run_id.description: The discovery run whose candidates were reviewed.

reviewer.description: Who made these decisions: a person or a role the owner recognizes.

x-rules.text: Holds a character other than whitespace: text that is only whitespace is refused.

decisions.description: Decisions in any order. A candidate is decided at most once.

items.description: One decision on one offered candidate window.

stream_id.description: The stream of the discovery run whose inventory holds the candidate.

candidate_id.description: The candidate, as its inventory names it.

decision.description: include: the window's frames join the frozen corpus version.

observation.description: What the reviewer saw in the window. target_present: a target in at least one frame. target_absent: no target seen, which is a review, not a verified absence. confuser: no target seen, but a moving object a model or a reviewer could mistake for one. unknown: the reviewer could not tell. An observation is never a label.

note.description: Why, in the reviewer's words. Optional, except for the reason other.

candidate_id.description: The candidate, as its inventory names it.

decision.description: exclude: the window's frames stay out of the frozen corpus version.

observation.description: What the reviewer saw in the window. target_present: a target in at least one frame. target_absent: no target seen, which is a review, not a verified absence. confuser: no target seen, but a moving object a model or a reviewer could mistake for one. unknown: the reviewer could not tell. An observation is never a label.

reason.description: Why the window stays out. no_value: nothing the corpus needs. quality: blur, damage or compression make it unusable. sensitive: it shows people, plates or other sensitive content. rights: its terms do not cover this use. duplicate: it repeats material already included. other: stated in the note.

note.description: Why, in the reviewer's words. Optional, except for the reason other.

decision.description: unreviewed: the reviewer has not decided the window; it stays out and is reported as unreviewed exposure.

x-rules.once: A stream and candidate pair is decided at most once.
x-rules.offered: Each decision names a candidate the run offers for review: selected, audit-sampled or a sibling window, of a stream outside the locked split.
x-rules.other-note: An exclude decision with the reason other states a note.
x-rules.consistent: No source frame lies in both an included and an excluded window.
